    • setMaxInputLength

      public PhoneticEngine.Builder setMaxInputLength(int maxInputLength)
      Sets the maximum input length allowed.

      A value less than 0 will reset the maximum input length to the default value of 666, see Hubert Blaine Wolfeschlegelsteinhausenbergerdorff Sr..

      Parameters:
      maxInputLength - the maximum input length allowed.
      Returns:
      This builder.

    • setMaxPhonemes

      public PhoneticEngine.Builder setMaxPhonemes(int maxPhonemes)
      Sets maximum number of phonemes the engine will handle.

      A value less than 0 will reset the maximum number of phonemes to the default 20.

      Parameters:
      maxPhonemes - The maximum number of phonemes the engine will handle.
      Returns:
      This builder.

    • setNameType

      public PhoneticEngine.Builder setNameType(NameType nameType)
      Sets the name type for the engine to be built.

      A null value will reset the name type to the default of NameType.GENERIC.

      Parameters:
      nameType - The type of names the engine will use.
      Returns:
      This builder.

    • setRuleType

      public PhoneticEngine.Builder setRuleType(RuleType ruleType)
      Sets the rule type for the engine to be built.

      A null value will reset the rule type to the default of RuleType.APPROX.

      Parameters:
      ruleType - The type of rules the engine will use.

      This builder.
